# Write as Nous (NoUs Loop product voice)

- Plain, calm, sentence case. Say what happened, then what happens next.
- No exclamation marks, no blame, no urgency tricks, no countdowns.
- Wellness-only claims: helps, supports, notices. Never treats, diagnoses, cures, clinical or medical.
- Product level only: name the product and the promise, never how the memory or learning core works inside.
- One next action, plain words. Name the enemy (big tech, data brokers) only in wall copy, never a person.
- Wall copy (posters, banners) is a separate voice: short, lowercase, defiant, three to six words. Never mix the two in one sentence.
- Never tag or name people. The brand lint (brand-rules.json) still runs on every post.
